items.name: Matcha Liquid (33g) – whisk upon order
items.body:
! All temperatures in °C. All measurements in grams.
## 33g Matcha Liquid = 2.7g matcha powder + 30g water
1. **Preheat whisk:** rinse with 80 °C water in the white matcha bowl; leave it there for cleaning until after you hand over the drink.
2. **Add:** 2.7g (<3.0g) matcha + 30–35g (<40g) water at 80 °C from the small water boiler.
3. **Dissolve:** all powder with circular motion, until no powder or clots.
4. **Whisk (foam):** W-shape, ~60 fast strokes in ~30 s, gently touching the bowl bottom.
5. **Finish:** a few slow Z strokes to break the bubbles you can see.
6. Check: no bubbles, matcha sticks to the side of the bowl, mirror-like surface.
7. Pour slowly over the ice cubes.

items.name: Boil boba (boba pot)
items.body:
! Ratio boba : water = 1 : 5. Weekdays 300g boba + 1500ml water · Weekends 700g boba + 3500ml water.
1. Measure water with the transparent bottle.
2. Close the lid. Press **FUNCTION**, then **START** — the pot boils water to 100 °C.
3. Measure boba in a matcha bowl.
4. After the **1st beep**, carefully open the lid (steam!). Stir with the spoon so they separate. Close the lid.
5. Keep the lid on. The pot cooks for 50 min by itself (2nd beep at 25 min). No buttons needed.
6. After the **3rd beep**, set up the filter pot. Pour boba into the filter over the strainer. Rinse off the slime with water, wearing gloves (hot!).
7. Make sure there's not much water left over.
8. Then make Black Sugar Boba.

items.name: Black Sugar Boba
items.body:
! Do this after the 3rd beep. Ratio boiled boba : hot water : black sugar syrup = 1 : 0.3 : 0.3 (e.g. 300g boba + 90ml water + 90g syrup; 600g + 180ml + 180g).
1. Pour boba from the filter straight into the flat stainless steel pot.
2. Put the pot on the scale and weigh the boba.
3. Get hot water in Cup A.
4. With the pot still on the scale, add the hot water, then the black sugar syrup.
5. Take it off the scale and stir before turning on the stove.
6. Plug in the electric stove and put the pot on it.
7. Press **POWER**, then **FUNCTION** — the display shows 2000.
8. Keep stirring the whole time and watch for bubbles.
9. Once boiling (½-inch bubbles at the edge), press **–** to turn it down to 1000.
10. Keep it at 75–80 °C with the orange thermometer, using UP / DOWN.
11. Keep stirring until the syrup is thick and sticks to the sides of the pot instead of running down.
12. Pour the black sugar boba back into the inner boba pot and put it back in the boba pot.
13. Press **Heat Preservation**, press **Temperature** until it shows **35 °C**. Keep at 35 °C.

items.name: Green tea
items.body:
! Put tea INTO hot water. Do NOT pour hot water on the tea.
| | Amount |
| Ratio tea : water : ice | 1 : 30 : 15 (e.g. 100 : 3000 : 1500 or 50 : 1500 : 750) |
| Tea | 100g, measured in a dry matcha bowl |
| Cup A | 2800g water + 200g ice = 3000g at **80 °C** (check with thermometer) |
| Cup B | 1500g ice |
| Time | 7 min, lid on (set a 5-min timer for ice + a 7-min timer for tea) |
1. Measure 100g tea into a dry matcha bowl.
2. Make the hot water in Cup A.
3. Put the tea into Cup A. **Don't stir.**
4. When the 5-min timer ends (2 min left), put the ice in Cup B.
5. When the 7-min timer ends, strain the tea into Cup B with the tea filter.
6. Stir until all the ice melts. Taste a few sips in the small white cup — it must not be bitter. Put the tea bottle in the fridge.

items.name: Mochi

| Bowl | What |

2. Electric stove: press power, then function, until it shows 2000.

items.name: Matcha Cloud (30 cups)
items.body:
## Stage 1 – dissolve matcha (Bowl A, small red-handle bowl)
1. 36g pure matcha + 150g water at 80 °C. Whisk to a paste.
2. Add 72g sweet matcha. Dissolve all the sugar. Whisk to a paste.
3. Add 500g milk. Whisk until water-like.
4. Add 45g salt cheese powder (green bag labeled "green tea powder") + 45g vanilla cheese powder.
5. Put Bowl A into Bowl B (large, ice + water). Mix with the blue hand mixer until no powder is visible.
6. Sift through the stainless sieve into a larger Bowl C.
## Stage 2 – whip
1. Add 360g heavy cream to Bowl C.
2. Mix with the blue hand mixer until you can draw a circle on the cream.

items.name: Tiramisu (classic & matcha, 7 boxes)
items.body:
! Tip: make at least 2 batches. Use half the mixture for classic, then add matcha paste to the other half for matcha.
1. Make 3 shots of coffee, add 6 ice cubes to cool, set aside. **Matcha:** dip = 9g matcha + 150g water + 20g powdered sugar + 8 ice cubes.
2. Soften 1 box of mascarpone (in its container) in a 60 °C water bath for 2 min. Mix until smooth.
3. Separate 3 eggs (yolks only). Add 20g sugar to the yolks in a small bowl (Bowl A).
4. Whisk the yolks over a hot water bath until pale and fluffy and the sugar is dissolved. Must reach at least 50 °C.
5. Add the yolk mix to the mascarpone and mix fully.
6. Add 1g vanilla concentrate.
7. Whip 260g heavy cream over an ice bath (Bowl B), adding 20g sugar in two batches, to stiff peaks.
8. Fold the whipped cream into Bowl A. **Matcha:** add a paste of 9g matcha + 30g water (Bowl C).
9. Break each ladyfinger in half. Roll in espresso/matcha dip so the center is soaked (matcha: hold 3 s after rolling).
10. Put the halves in the container and cover fully with the mixture.
11. Repeat step 10.
12. Top with a layer of cocoa powder / matcha powder.

items.name: Closing checklist
items.body:
## Cleaning & hygiene
1. Clean the round white lid of every ice cream flavor **daily** with the black brush.
2. Ice cream machine → **NIGHT** mode.
3. Clean the jasmine milk tea machine.
4. Clean all matcha bowls; leave them upside down on the green mat.
5. Clean all matcha whisks; dry them on the rack.
6. Check and refill tissues, straws, cups, utensils, packaging.
7. Wipe tables and chairs, tidy pickup & dining area, put seats back.
8. Sort and take out trash, clean the bins, put in new bags.
9. Sweep and mop from inside out; clean floor drains.
10. Wash all dishes and cups and put them back in their drying spots.
11. Make sure the AC is **ON at 72°**.
12. Clean and charge all scales.
## Inventory & equipment
1. Fill in the inventory sheets.
2. Check and record fridge and freezer temperatures.
3. Check the ice maker is working.
4. Tea in the fridge; clean the tea pitcher.
## Cashier & security
1. Confirm the key is in the lock box.
2. Make sure the cameras are working.
